technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with price above all key MAs and rising RSI across timeframes, but overbought stochastic conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 17.87), and negative CMF create pullback risk—suitable for moderate-risk entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 64 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 64 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD bullish crossover and rising RSI across timeframes provides technical momentum entry, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) and tight support at 36.29.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2), overbought stochastic conditions with bearish cross, weak trend confirmation (ADX 17.87), negative CMF, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk within 64 days create unacceptable risk/reward in unfavorable macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows bullish momentum (price above MAs, MACD crossover, rising RSI) and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, but entry quality is compromised by overbought stochastic conditions and weak trend confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) combined with high earnings risk in 64 days and negative CMF accumulation signal creates unacceptable downside risk in unfavorable macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals bullish but fundamentals, sentiment conviction, and risk assessment all weak; bear case dominates
